note: b0 is the root backend; kind sqlite = SqliteVFS (chown/chmod each entry as listed; root 0755 0:0), memory = MemoryVFS (no modes); every symlink resolves in the caller's namespace (absolute from its root, relative from the link's directory, .. at a mount root to the mount point's parent), 40 hops then ELOOP, search checked per hop; steps run on composite.as(cred of as) in order, carrying state; created files 0644 and directories 0755, the caller's uid and primary gid, but in a setgid sqlite directory the directory's gid, and new directories setgid; a directory's defaultAcl masks a new entry's create mode (0666/0777) class by class instead of the umask, and a new directory inherits it; rename keeps meta and default ACLs; stat mode has no type bits; readdir names sorted
